title: Maximum Area of a Piece of Cake After Horizontal and Vertical Cuts
description: Calculate the maximum area of a piece of cake by finding the maximum distance between adjacent horizontal and vertical cuts.
pseudocode:
1. Add 0 and h to horizontalCuts, 0 and w to verticalCuts.
2. Sort both arrays.
3. Find max difference between adjacent elements in both arrays.
4. Return (maxH * maxW) % (10^9 + 7).

steps.note: Sort cuts to prepare for calculating gaps.
